newsitem.title: CHINA: China newspaper calls for securities law in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China newspaper calls for securities law in 1997.

text.p: The official China Securities newspaper called on Thursday for the long-awaited Securities Law to be promulgated in 1997 to help regulate China's fast-developing and highly volatile stock markets.
The newspaper published a signed article urging Chinese leaders to accelerate the process of approving the Securities Law, the subject of heated discussions since 1993.
Analysts say the main obstacle is that different departments in the central government have so far failed to agree on how power and responsibility for securities matters will be apportioned.
